project.title: Δ-Potential Learning (ΔPL) for Protein Binding Affinity
project.goal: Train a cycle-consistent ΔΔG predictor for protein–protein and protein–ligand interfaces.
project.algorithm: Δ-Potential Learning parameterizes ΔΔG as f(σ→σ′, c) = h(σ′, c) − h(σ, c), where h : Σ × C → ℝ is a learned scalar potential. This enforces anti-symmetry, transitivity, and reflexivity exactly by construction, rather than as soft penalties. Theoretical sample complexity drops from O(|Σ|²·d/ε²) to O(|Σ|·d/ε²).
project.status: Late-stage evaluation blitz: ~13 SLURM jobs running in parallel on Savio (savio3_gpu, lowprio, savio2_gpu, co_nilah) across ProtAttBA folds, ProteinGym / BindingGym LoRA, FireProt transfer, and zero-shot ESM-2 / ESM-1v / ProtBert baselines. Six sub-agents are running in parallel for the comparison matrix (StaB-ddG env + launch, ESM-IF, SaProt, PPB-Affinity LoRA-DPL, ATLAS loader, Tsuboyama loader).

model.name: DPL + LoRA on ESM-2 650M
model.params_trainable: ≈2.7M (0.4%) via LoRA r=16 on query + value
variants: DPL (anti-symmetric scalar potential, frozen or LoRA)
ablations: LoRA r=16 vs r=32 (r=16 wins: ρ=0.4928 vs 0.4882, data-limited)

results.title: SKEMPI headline (5 seeds × 5-fold GKF, n=7826)
results.note: Paired bootstrap Δρ vs UN = +0.091 [+0.042, +0.142], p < 0.0001

results.title: StaB-ddG head-to-head (leakage-corrected, n = 230)
results.note: 100% of StaB-ddG's 81 test PDBs have homologs in SKEMPI training at 30% identity — the original +0.59 was leakage. After strict matched-cluster correction the ensemble still beats StaB by Δρ = +0.042.

results.title: Competitor baseline

rows.method: GearBind (Cai et al. 2024, Nat Commun) split-by-complex SKEMPI

results.note: About +0.07 above our strict leakage-free ensemble — we may not be SOTA once GearBind is counted.

results.title: FireProt negative result
results.note: DPL collapses to a 20×20 per-protein substitution matrix at dense positions (1PGA alone = 18.8% of items). DPL is a sparse-context regularizer — a principled failure mode, not a dataset quirk.

insights: Cycle-consistency as an inductive bias gives exact (not soft) ΔΔG physics constraints and measurably reduces variance on small datasets.
Identity-shuffle vs geometry-shuffle controls cleanly audit whether 'geometric' tokens are secretly residue-identity detectors.
Cluster leakage at 30% identity invalidates most ΔΔG leaderboards; GroupKFold-by-PDB alone is not enough.
DPL helps when per-context mutations are sparse and hurts when they are dense — a clean, interpretable failure mode.
ProteinTTT (Bushuiev 2024) and Singhal 2025 iterative distillation are the closest prior art; earlier TTT / FO-PRM framings had to be reworked.

PILOT B1 dispatched:
- **Job 33396614** running on n0215. SKEMPI fold 0 seed 0, 10 epochs, ~2.5h.
- Smoke test passed: CCT loss went 2.77 → 0.43 (6.5× drop) ep1→ep2, no NaN.
- Interesting finding: **CCT is non-zero on pure DPL** because head dropout breaks strict cycle-closure per step. So CCT doubles as a **dropout-consistency regularizer** beyond just the pair-term/struct-fusion/cluster-cond non-linearities.

**Honest prediction: Δρ ≈ +0.01 to +0.02**, likely within noise. CCT on pure DPL is structurally close to a no-op because DPL's form is already reflexive by construction. The +0.12 gap to RDE comes from structural information, not from the loss function. **But this pilot fixes the paper's internal inconsistency** — every "ΔPL LoRA" headline number was plain MSE, the CCT claim was propped up by the v2 frozen-feature pipeline. Now CCT actually exists in the LoRA workhorse.

PILOT E1 dispatched:
- **Pilot job 33396572** running on A40. Fold 0 seed 0, 10 epochs, 12h walltime.
- **Residual target has 36% less variance** than raw y (2.30 vs 3.25 MSE) — room exists for DPL to contribute.
- 85.4% of train rows have RDE signal, 922 unmatched rows dropped (15%).
- Epoch 1: `resid_mse=2.30, final_rho=+0.088` (early, DPL noise dominating).

**Honest prediction:** **+0.505 to +0.515** final Spearman on fold 0 — right at the +0.510 success threshold. The residual structure exists but DPL and RDE errors are largely collinear on SKEMPI, so the boost buys at most +0.01-0.02 over RDE alone. ETA ~100 min.

Failure modes flagged:
1. DPL noise may not converge — need lower head LR
2. Error modes may be redundant (null hypothesis)
3. RDE cluster splits vs DPL cluster splits could mismatch → evaluation optimism
4. Dropping 922 unmatched rows shrinks training set by 15%

**E — Ensemble/Distill** back:

1. **BoostΔPL**: fit DPL on RDE's residuals (boosting). Directly stress-tests whether DPL is complementary vs redundant to RDE. Best expected Δρ/complexity ratio.
2. **CycleDistill**: distill the 5-model stacked ensemble (DPL + RDE + StaB + PPAC + ProtAttBA) into a sequence-only ESM-2 650M student using ~1M AlphaFold-DB synthetic mutations, then fine-tune on SKEMPI. Sidesteps the "needs a PDB" reviewer objection. Second headline contribution.

Other ideas: StackPL, MoE-Gate, VarWeight, TTA-Cluster.

1 more agent running (F training dynamics).

**D — Physics/Thermo** back:

1. **TCDH (Temperature-Conditioned Dual Head)**: predict (ΔH, ΔS) separately, combine as ΔH − T·ΔS. Unlocks joint training across SKEMPI/Tsuboyama/ProThermDB at heterogeneous temperatures. Extends the multi-site identifiability theorem to two latent potentials.
2. **RRAT (REF15-Residual Aux Targets)**: multi-task auxiliary regression on Rosetta REF15's 8 decomposed energy terms. Highest expected Δρ + a publishable "which component carries the signal" ablation.

Also mentioned (not top picks): EAS anti-symmetry loss, BEMED Boltzmann-ensemble matching, MBLP Markov-blanket locality, FEPD FEP-distillation pretraining.

  2. **InterfacePot**: cross-chain pair term gated by ESM cross-attention, restricted to interface residues only. Orthogonal to AntiSymTwin.

- **B — Loss**:
  1. **LoRA-internal CCT**: finally apply the cycle-closure loss inside the LoRA workhorse (the architecture-critique agent's headline finding). Δρ=5/5, half-day implementation.

Feature extraction ran in 68s over 345 SKEMPI PDBs. 8-d per-residue vector: `conf, phi_sin/cos, psi_sin/cos, sasa, contact_count, iface_z`. Head dim 1280 → 1288. 13th agent complete: **GAP 2 — cluster-conditioned context**. Smoke test validates: train loss drops, val RMSE drops under zero-init OOV embedding. **15 full-run jobs running (33383621–35)**.

Honest prediction: **+0.02 to +0.04 (central estimate +0.03)** on the SKEMPI cluster-aware pool — ~¼ of the +0.12 gap to RDE-Network. The mechanism is training-time regularization (freeing `h` to fit within-cluster residual), not test-time cluster info (val rows always get OOV token by construction). Same limitation as the per-protein bias but operates at the cluster level. 2 more agents running.

12th agent complete: **GAP 1 — Explicit pair term**. Smoke test passed (ρ=+0.314 on fold 0, 1 epoch). Head params 0.5M → 1.26M. **15 full-sweep jobs queued (33384671–33384685)**.

Honest prediction: **+0.04 to +0.07 (max +0.09)** — closes 30-50% of the DPL→RDE gap but not all of it. k-distribution ceiling (~65-70% of SKEMPI is single mutations where pair term = 0). ESM context already captures local epistasis implicitly. Most of RDE's edge is explicit 3D geometry, not pair-interaction signal. Follow-up: pair-term gated by contact distances. 3 more agents running.

11th agent complete: **GAP 4 — ESM-2 3B backbone swap**. Smoke test stable, `hidden_size=2560` auto-detected, LoRA params 5.9M (5× bump), fits on A40. **15 Phase-2 jobs queued** (33383907–927) with dependency on Phase-1 pretrain (33383906) since 3B Phase-1 adapter dims differ from 650M.

Honest prediction: **+0.015–0.035** on SKEMPI cluster-aware (below the +0.02–0.05 upper bound). Published ESM-2 scaling curves show diminishing returns past 650M on mutation-effect tasks. 3-seed reads in this range should NOT be treated as wins (min-5-seeds rule — signs have flipped before). 4 more agents running.

10th agent complete: **DPL+RDE ensemble on full cluster-aware SKEMPI** (n=5694):

| Model | ρ |
|---|---|
| DPL alone | +0.386 |
| RDE alone | +0.490 |
| **Best blend (α=0.8 RDE)** | **+0.500** |

**Δρ over RDE alone: +0.010 (95% CI [+0.005, +0.015], p<0.001)** — significant but tiny. DPL carries small orthogonal signal to RDE. 5 more agents running.

This is the first real "our ensemble beats a structural baseline" number on the full cluster-aware pool. Not as dramatic as the StaB-ddG ensemble on n=230 (+0.014), but it's on a much larger sample (5694 vs 230).
